content: {"paper_id":"lab-c0b4fa3ab5d5","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","exact_quote":"Label Distribution Learning with Biased Annotations Assisted by Multi-Label Learning","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题明确以标记分布学习为核心任务，摘要也围绕LDL与标签分布恢复展开。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Assisted by Multi-Label Learning","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题表明多标记学习被用于辅助本文方法，摘要中硬multi-hot标签也体现多标记学习表示。"},{"keyword_id":"label-enhancement","exact_quote":"we first degenerate the soft label distribution into a hard multi-hot label and then recover the true label information for each instance","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法先把软标签分布退化为硬多热逻辑标签，再恢复真实标签信息，符合由逻辑标签构建更细致标签分布。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"we address the LDL with biased annotations problem from a novel perspective","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以带偏标注的LDL问题为研究条件，处理不准确标签分布监督。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"assuming that the multi-label space for predicting label distributions is low-rank offers a more reasonable approach to capturing label correlations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"显式采用多标记空间的低秩假设/近似来建模相关结构，属于低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"offers a more reasonable approach to capturing label correlations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法显式以低秩多标记空间捕获标签相关性，满足标签相关性建模定义。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"To address the issue of biased annotations","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将带偏标注/不准确监督作为实质研究条件，属于弱监督学习中的不精确监督设定。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","reason_zh":"有从带偏观测恢复真实分布的表述，但输出是否为待恢复数据而非提升LDL预测不明确，缺少以数据补全/恢复为研究任务的充分证据。"}],"input_issues":[]}
